name: ShinyText-TS-TW
blurb: A bright highlight sweeps across text from left to right, looping continuously.
description: Renders text with a moving linear gradient shine effect that sweeps horizontally. Supports directional control, yoyo (bidirectional) looping, configurable speed and spread angle, and optional pause on hover.
use_when: A headline or CTA wants a subtle, elegant lighting effect that draws attention without distraction.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical text where the animation might interfere with readability.
a11y: Text is readable; shine is a visual overlay using background-clip. Motion can be paused on hover.
